title: First workout
description: Choose movements, start the workout, log and finish.
steps: Open exercise selection from Start workout.
Choose exercises, then press Start to begin.
Edit weight and repetitions, then log a set.
Finish the workout and review its summary.

title: Repeat a workout
description: Use completed history to start a new workout with copied targets.
steps: Repeat it to create a new active workout.
Review copied targets and log a set.

title: Finish and review
description: Finish a fully logged workout and inspect its summary.
steps: Inspect the completed summary and return to history.
